name.ja: HG 1/72 メイレスケンブ斬

ja: KEN OKUYAMA DESIGNによる構造検証を経て立体化された第二部主人公機を最速立体化！
■巨大な武装を操る為、マッシブなシルエットに生まれ変わった。
■腕部の機関砲は着脱可能。ケンブと武装の共有を想定したアタッチメントを搭載。
■人体における大胸筋のような構造を模した胸部シリンダーギミックは、伸縮可動を再現。
■ケンブ斬の全高ほどもある、迫力の大型の超熱振式戦闘長刀が付属。
■背部ウェポンラックには各種武装を着脱可能。
TVアニメ「境界戦機」第二部は４月開始！！第一部のエピソードはBANDAI SPIRITS 公式 YouTubeにて全話無料配信中！
en: The fastest 3D version of the main character in the second part, which was made into 3D after structural verification by KEN OKUYAMA DESIGN!
• Reborn with a massive silhouette in order to control huge weapons.
• The machine gun on the arm is removable. Equipped with an attachment designed to share weapons with Kenbu.
• The chest cylinder gimmick, which mimics the structure of the pectoralis major muscle in the human body, reproduces the ability to expand and contract.
• Comes with an impressively large super heat wave fighting long sword that is as tall as Kenbuzan.
• Various weapons can be attached and detached from the back weapon rack.
The second part of the TV anime "Kyoukai Senki" starts in 4! ! All episodes of the first part are available for free on BANDAI SPIRITS official YouTube!

ja: ハンドパーツ 平手（左右）​、武器持ち手（左右）​、銃持ち手（右）
en: Super heat wave combat long sword x 1
Hand parts: open hand (left and right), weapon handle (left and right), gun handle (right)
